text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Who could've predicted the three-way
showdown
would turn out like that?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: But, still... It was absolute fire!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I've never been so glad to see a race in
person! I'll
be counting down the days to
the next one!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...I couldn't win.
Neither could Scarlet...
or even
Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
(There's dust everywhere... It's so loud.
And
they're on fire! But I won't give up.
Because...)

text_block_list.name: Scarlet and Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'M THE BEST!
I'M NUMBER ONE!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'll never, ever forget this race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The crowd showers Aston Machan in
applause as she walks toward the
runner's tunnel. As if
enraptured by it,
she looks up at the stands.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
You were so close, Machan. You were
awesome!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I never thought I'd see another
three-way
standoff like that! Thank you
so much!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: This beautiful sound. This beautiful view.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's always loveliest when those two are
around.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I've truly been blessed, with both
friends... and
rivals.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Let's all do it again sometime.
Someplace.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It'll definitely be another great race
next
time.
